name: Tree of Tortu

attributes.attribute: one of the five great trees of Ireland
an ash, sacred to the Celts
so huge it stretched across Ireland when felled

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Tree of Tortu is one of the five great trees of Ireland. It was an ash, and the ash was sacred to the Celts. The Tree of Tortu grew to a huge size. When it was felled, it stretched across the whole of Ireland. Its other names are the Ash of Tortu and the Tree of Dath-I. It stood with the other great trees as part of the sacred landscape of Irish myth.

okr.objective: Record the great sacred ash of the Irish landscape.
